testCases.name: test_defective_return_policy
testCases.input: I bought these boots 45 days ago, but the sole separated.
testCases.actualOutput: The 30-day window has passed, but a defective item can still be reviewed. Send support your order number and photos.
testCases.expectedOutput: Preserve the defective-item review exception and provide the next step.

metricsData.name: Policy correctness [GEval]
metricsData.reason: The response correctly identifies that although the purchase was 45 days old and outside the normal 30-day window, the defective-item exception applies because the sole separated. It matches the expected policy by preserving review for a defective item and giving the proper next step to contact support with order number and photos. It also avoids guaranteeing a refund and appropriately routes the case for review.
